stories.headline: Hunter Schafer Reveals She Had Gender-Affirming Bottom Surgery - Variety
stories.summary: 'Euphoria' star Hunter Schafer revealed she had bottom surgery in late 2025, changing her genitals to align with her gender identity.

stories.headline: Richard Riehle, Character Actor in ‘Office Space,’ ‘Star Trek,’ ‘Bridesmaids’ and More, Dies at 78 - Variety
stories.summary: Richard Riehle, known for his role as Tom Smykowski in "Office Space" and many other character actor parts, died of natural causes Oct. 15. He was 78.

stories.headline: Jon Stewart to stay at ‘The Daily Show’ through the 2028 election - CNN
stories.summary: Jon Stewart will remain at the helm of Comedy Central’s “The Daily Show” through December 2028, extending his once-a-week hosting role through the next presidential election.

stories.headline: Gwyneth Paltrow Stars In 'The Apology' Netflix Series (Exclusive) - Deadline
stories.summary: Netflix has given a two-season straight-to-series order to 'The Apology', a thriller drama from A24., starring Oscar winner Gwyneth Paltrow

stories.headline: Model Sahara Ray, Justin Bieber's ex, dies at 34 - USA Today
stories.summary: Model Sahara Ray, once romantically linked to celebrities like Justin Bieber and Cody Simpson, has died at the age of 34.

stories.headline: Dan Lin Out As Netflix Film Boss, Latest Victim In Executive Purge - Deadline
stories.summary: Dan Lin is out as the head of film at Netflix in a move that has been largely speculated for weeks, following major layoffs at the streamer.

stories.headline: Watch Cardi B Blaze Through Her No-Brakes Tiny Desk Performance - Pitchfork
stories.summary: The rapper’s backing band gave fresh, rock-inflected updates to singles like “ErrTime,” “Up,” and “Bodak Yellow”
